mapper.select: select a.id,a.insp_task_id inspTaskId ,a.robot_id robotId,a.type,a.point,a.abnormal,a.abnormal_info abnormalInfo, a.image_base64,a.create_time,c.region from insp_task_result a left join robot_task b on a.insp_task_id=b.id left join config_task c on c.id=b.task_id where c.room_code=#{roomCode} and a.abnormal <> 0 and a.create_time>CURRENT_DATE
select task_status from robot_task where id = #{id}
